provenance.note: Introduced version; no votes on file. The repeal section removes the sections that SB 554 (2021) added (storage, loss or theft reporting, supervision of minors, and school-grounds carry policy). SECTION 3 (ORS 166.370) and SECTION 4 (ORS 166.262) strike the Capitol and airport carry limits for licence holders; SECTION 5 (ORS 166.291) cuts the sheriff's fee from $100 initial and $75 renewal to $50 for issuance or renewal. Struck words make those sections unsafe to quote, so they are described here.
